title: shortcut guide only displays windows shortcuts
author: denisvanw

judgment.rationale: The report names Photoshop and Chrome but does not give one exact foreground app, activation method, or sequence that shows the wrong page. Without that discriminator, a maintainer cannot tell whether app identification/manifest lookup or Shortcut Guide activation/context selection failed.
evidence: The reporter states that PowerToys preview 0.101.2712.0 on Windows 25H2 shows Windows File Explorer shortcuts regardless of the focused window.
Photoshop and Chrome are named as applications expected to have shortcuts.
There are no comments, screenshots, attachments, or exact Shortcut Guide activation steps.
judgment.recommended_action: Request one exact failing foreground-app and activation sequence, including the process name.

fix_assessment.rationale: The report is not yet specific enough to establish an applicable PowerToys code fix; the foreground-app lookup and guide invocation path cannot be distinguished.

issue_context.summary: Shortcut Guide reportedly shows the Windows/File Explorer shortcut page for different focused applications, including Chrome and Photoshop, but no exact failing app/invocation sequence is documented.
known_information: The report lists preview 0.101.2712.0 and Windows 25H2.
The reporter says the same Windows File Explorer shortcuts page appears whichever window has focus and names Photoshop and Chrome as expected app examples.
The thread has no comments or attachments.
inferences: The failure could be in identifying the foreground process, selecting its shortcut manifest, or deciding which guide page to display; the report does not distinguish these.
issue_context.analysis: The application examples and visible symptom are useful, but the activation method and one reproducible foreground process are missing. Request a minimal Chrome example rather than a generic bug report or broad diagnostics.
initial_investigation: Reviewed the full issue body and confirmed no discussion, screenshots, or duplicate/fix links are present.

Shortcut Guide's app-specific data path is owned by src/modules/ShortcutGuide and its manifest/index generator; the report provides no foreground-process or manifest-selection evidence to identify a failing branch.

Rechecked the complete report: preview build, Photoshop/Chrome examples, no exact foreground process or activation method. #48968 is tray activation-shortcut tracking, not evidence that this guide context issue is fixed.

information_gaps.information: One exact failing sequence for a named app, including the focused process and how Shortcut Guide is opened
information_gaps.why_needed: Separates foreground-app/manifest selection from Shortcut Guide activation or page-selection behavior.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Use Chrome as the example: state its process name, the exact Shortcut Guide key/gesture used, and the numbered steps from focusing Chrome to seeing the Windows shortcuts page.

actions.label: Provide a Chrome Shortcut Guide repro

comment.body:
Thanks for naming Chrome and Photoshop and explaining that the guide keeps showing the Windows/File Explorer shortcut page. I still cannot tell which foreground-app and activation path produced that page.

Please provide one exact Chrome example: the Chrome process name, the key or gesture you use to open Shortcut Guide, and short numbered steps from focusing Chrome through the guide appearing. This will distinguish foreground-app/manifest selection from guide activation or page selection; that focused repro is enough for the first check.

status.label: Request a focused Shortcut Guide repro
status.detail: A specific foreground-app and activation sequence is needed to locate the Shortcut Guide selection path.

next_action.label: Provide a Chrome Shortcut Guide repro
next_action.reason: Identify the focused process and activation path before proposing an implementation.
